regras.label: Peerless Aim
regras.text: When you miss with an attack roll, you hit instead.

regras.label: Improve Fate
regras.text: You or a creature within 60 feet adds or subtracts 2d4 on a d20 roll after seeing whether it passed or failed.

when.situation: you or a creature within 60 ft

regras.label: Overwhelming Strike
regras.text: On a natural 20 on the attack d20, deal extra damage equal to the increased ability score (Strength or Dexterity), of the attack's damage type.

effects.formula: @abilities.str.value (or dex: the ability score increased by this feat)

regras.label: Overcome Defenses
regras.text: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage ignores Resistance.

regras.label: Potent Spellcasting
regras.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Cleric cantrips.

regras.label: Divine Strike
regras.text: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon attack, deal an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (2d8 with Improved Blessed Strikes).

regras.label: Potent Spellcasting
regras.text: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your Druid cantrips.

regras.label: Primal Strike
regras.text: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon attack or a Beast form attack, deal an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (2d8 with Improved Elemental Fury).

regras.label: Brutal Strike
regras.text: With Reckless Attack, forgo Advantage on a Strength attack; if it hits, deal extra damage (1d10 at level 9; 2d10 with Improved Brutal Strike (2)) and apply an effect (Hamstring Blow or Forceful Blow).

when.situation: Reckless Attack active; forgo the Advantage

regras.label: Improved Brutal Strike (2)
regras.text: Brutal Strike's extra damage becomes 2d10 and you can apply two Brutal Strike effects.

effects.other: Brutal Strike deals 2d10 and allows two effects

regras.label: Staggering Blow
regras.text: New Brutal Strike effect: the target has Disadvantage on its next Saving Throw and can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.

effects.other: target has Disadvantage on the next saving throw

regras.label: Sundering Blow
regras.text: New Brutal Strike effect: the next attack roll by another creature against the target gets a +5 bonus (one attack only).

when.situation: target marked by Sundering Blow, attack by another creature

regras.label: Danger Sense
regras.text: Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

regras.label: Feral Instinct
regras.text: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

regras.label: Frenzy
regras.text: With Reckless Attack and Rage active, the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength attack takes extra d6s equal to your Rage damage bonus.

when.situation: Reckless Attack + Rage; first target hit on the turn

regras.label: Indomitable Might
regras.text: If your total on a Strength check or Saving Throw is lower than your Strength score, use the score instead.

regras.label: Primal Knowledge
regras.text: While raging, Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks can use Strength.

regras.label: Rage: Strength Advantage
regras.text: Advantage on Strength checks and Strength Saving Throws.

regras.label: Rage: Damage
regras.text: A Strength-based attack (weapon or Unarmed Strike) that deals damage gains the Rage damage bonus.

regras.label: Reckless Attack
regras.text: On your first attack of the turn, gain Advantage on Strength attacks until your next turn (attacks against you also have Advantage).

regras.label: Relentless Rage
regras.text: When you drop to 0 Hit Points while raging, make a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw (+5 for each use after the first; resets on a rest); on a success, your Hit Points become twice your Barbarian level.

regras.label: Bardic Inspiration
regras.text: When the target fails a D20 Test, it rolls its Inspiration die (d6, scales with level) and adds it to the d20.

when.situation: inspired creature failed a D20 Test

regras.label: Countercharm
regras.text: Reaction: you or a creature within 30 feet that failed a Saving Throw against Charmed or Frightened rerolls it with Advantage.

regras.label: Cutting Words
regras.text: Reaction, spending a Bardic Inspiration use: subtract the die from the damage, ability check, or attack roll of a creature within 60 feet.

regras.label: Expertise
regras.text: Gain Expertise in chosen skills: your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for them.

regras.label: Jack of All Trades
regras.text: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to ability checks that don't already use it.

regras.label: Peerless Skill
regras.text: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, spend a Bardic Inspiration use and add the die; if you still fail, the use isn't expended.

regras.label: Disciple of Life
regras.text: A spell that heals using a spell slot restores extra Hit Points: 2 plus the slot's level.

when.situation: spell with a slot that restores HP

regras.label: Sear Undead
regras.text: When you use Turn Undead, roll d8s (number equal to your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1) and deal Radiant damage to those that fail.

regras.label: Supreme Healing
regras.text: Healing dice from spells or Channel Divinity use their maximum value instead of being rolled.

regras.label: Improved Blessed Strikes
regras.text: Divine Strike increases to 2d8; Potent Spellcasting grants Temporary Hit Points (2 times your Wisdom modifier) when you deal damage with a cantrip.

effects.other: Divine Strike: 2d8; cantrip: Temporary Hit Points 2x Wisdom mod.

regras.label: Improved Elemental Fury
regras.text: Primal Strike increases to 2d8; Druid cantrips with a range of 10 feet or more gain +300 feet.

regras.label: Great Weapon Fighting
regras.text: On damage with a two-handed melee weapon (Two-Handed or Versatile), a 1 or 2 on a damage die counts as a 3.

regras.label: Two-Weapon Fighting
regras.text: On the extra attack with a Light weapon, add your ability modifier to the damage if you aren't already.

when.situation: extra attack with the second weapon

regras.label: Alert
regras.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative.

regras.label: Grappler
regras.text: Advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you.

regras.label: Savage Attacker
regras.text: Once per turn, when you hit with a weapon, roll the damage dice twice and use either result.

regras.label: Improved Critical 19-20
regras.text: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20 on the d20.

regras.label: Indomitable
regras.text: When you fail a Saving Throw, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; you must use the new roll.

regras.label: Remarkable Athlete (Initiative)
regras.text: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

regras.label: Remarkable Athlete (Athletics)
regras.text: Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks.

regras.label: Studied Attacks
regras.text: If you miss a creature with an attack, you have Advantage on your next attack against it until the end of your next turn.

when.situation: missed the previous attack against the same target, before the end of your next turn

regras.label: Superior Critical 18-20
regras.text: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on an 18 to 20 on the d20.

regras.label: Defy Death
regras.text: Advantage on Death Saving Throws; a 18 to 20 on the d20 counts as a 20.

effects.other: a result of 18-20 on the d20 counts as 20 (critical: 1 HP)

regras.label: Tactical Mind
regras.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a use of Second Wind and add 1d10 to the check (if you still fail, the use isn't expended).

cost.resource: 1 use of Second Wind (returned if the check still fails)

regras.label: Agonizing Blast
regras.text: Add your Charisma modifier to the damage of one chosen damage-dealing Warlock cantrip.

regras.label: Eldritch Mind
regras.text: Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws to maintain Concentration.

regras.label: Eldritch Smite
regras.text: Once per turn, when you hit with your pact weapon, deal extra Force damage: 1d8 plus 1d8 per level of the Pact Magic slot expended.

regras.label: Lifedrinker
regras.text: Once per turn, when you hit with your pact weapon, deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage.

cost.resource: 1 Hit Die (roll and regain HP + Constitution mod.)

regras.label: Pact of the Blade
regras.text: Attack and deal damage with your pact weapon using Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity; the damage can be Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or its normal type.

effects.replace: damage type of your choice: Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or the normal one

regras.label: Empowered Spell
regras.text: Reroll up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) of the spell's damage dice and use the new results.

regras.label: Extended Spell (Concentration)
regras.text: If the spell requires Concentration, you have Advantage on Saving Throws to maintain it.

when.situation: maintain Concentration on an Extended Spell

regras.label: Heightened Spell
regras.text: Give one target Disadvantage on Saving Throws against the spell.

when.situation: a target's saving throw against the caster's spell

regras.label: Seeking Spell
regras.text: When you miss with a spell's attack roll, reroll the d20 and use the new roll.

regras.label: Transmuted Spell
regras.text: Change the spell's damage type to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

regras.label: Deflect Attacks
regras.text: Reaction: reduce the attack's damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier plus your Monk level; if reduced to 0, you can redirect it (the target makes a Dexterity Saving Throw).

when.situation: attack that hit you with Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing damage (any type with Deflect Energy)

regras.label: Disciplined Survivor
regras.text: When you fail a Saving Throw, reroll it and use the new roll (proficiency in all Saving Throws is passive).

regras.label: Empowered Strikes
regras.text: Your Unarmed Strike can deal Force damage or its normal type.

regras.label: Martial Arts
regras.text: Unarmed or with Monk weapons, without armor or a Shield: use the Martial Arts die in place of normal damage and Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage.

regras.label: Wholeness of Body
regras.text: Bonus Action: heal Hit Points equal to a Martial Arts die plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

regras.label: Evasion
regras.text: On a Dexterity Saving Throw for half damage: a success means no damage, a failure means half (doesn't work while Incapacitated).

when.situation: effect that deals half damage on a success

regras.label: Aura of Protection
regras.text: You and allies in the aura (10 feet) gain a bonus to Saving Throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

regras.label: Holy Nimbus (Saves)
regras.text: Advantage on Saving Throws forced by Fiends or Undead while the nimbus is active.

when.situation: forced by a Fiend or Undead, nimbus active

regras.label: Sacred Weapon
regras.text: Add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to attacks with the imbued melee weapon for 10 minutes; damage is normal or Radiant.

effects.other: damage type of your choice: normal or Radiant

regras.label: Elusive
regras.text: No attack roll has Advantage against you unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

regras.label: Evasion
regras.text: On a Dexterity Saving Throw for half damage: a success means no damage, a failure means half.

when.situation: effect that deals half damage on a success

regras.label: Expertise
regras.text: In two skills you're proficient in (two more at level 6), your Proficiency Bonus is doubled.

regras.label: Expertise
regras.text: In two skills you're proficient in, your Proficiency Bonus is doubled.

regras.label: Deft Explorer
regras.text: Gain Expertise in one skill you're proficient in.

regras.label: Slippery Mind
regras.text: Proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma Saving Throws.

regras.label: Sneak Attack
regras.text: Once per turn, deal extra damage dice (scales with Rogue level; 1d6 at level 1) if you have Advantage, or an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you have no Disadvantage, with a Finesse or ranged weapon.
regras.auto: Advantage on the attack or an ally adjacent to the target

regras.label: Cunning Strike
regras.text: When you deal Sneak Attack damage, trade damage dice for effects (Poison 1d6, Trip, Disarm...); DC 8 + Dex + Prof.

effects.other: effect with a saving throw by the target, DC 8+@dex+@prof

regras.label: Steady Aim
regras.text: Bonus Action: Advantage on your next attack this turn; only if you haven't moved, and your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

cost.resource: Bonus Action; without having moved this turn

regras.label: Stroke of Luck
regras.text: When you fail a D20 Test, the roll becomes a 20.

regras.label: Reliable Talent
regras.text: On a skill or tool check you're proficient in, a d20 roll of 9 or lower counts as a 10.

regras.label: Thief's Reflexes
regras.text: Two turns in the first round: your normal Initiative and Initiative minus 10.

regras.label: Escape the Horde
regras.text: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

regras.label: Multiattack Defense
regras.text: When a creature hits you, it has Disadvantage on its other attacks against you this turn.

when.situation: attacker already hit the character this turn

regras.label: Colossus Slayer
regras.text: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d8 weapon damage if the target is below its maximum Hit Points.
regras.auto: target with HP below its maximum

regras.label: Precise Hunter
regras.text: Advantage on attack rolls against the creature marked by Hunter's Mark.

regras.label: Foe Slayer
regras.text: The damage die of Hunter's Mark changes from d6 to d10.

regras.label: Innate Sorcery
regras.text: While active: Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls and +1 to your spell save DC.

regras.label: Elemental Affinity
regras.text: When you cast a spell of the chosen damage type, add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll.

regras.label: Brave
regras.text: Advantage on Saving Throws against or to end the Frightened condition.

regras.label: Dwarven Resilience
regras.text: Advantage on Saving Throws against or to end the Poisoned condition (and Resistance to Poison damage).

regras.label: Fey Ancestry
regras.text: Advantage on Saving Throws against or to end the Charmed condition.

regras.label: Gnomish Cunning
regras.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws.

regras.label: Fire's Burn
regras.text: When you hit and deal damage, deal an extra 1d10 Fire damage.

when.situation: attacked and dealt damage; Prof times per Long Rest

regras.label: Frost's Chill
regras.text: When you hit and deal damage, deal an extra 1d6 Cold damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.

when.situation: attacked and dealt damage; Prof times per Long Rest

regras.label: Hill's Tumble
regras.text: When you hit a Large or smaller creature and deal damage, it has the Prone condition.

when.situation: attacked and dealt damage; Prof times per Long Rest

regras.label: Large Form
regras.text: Become Large for 10 minutes (level 5+): Advantage on Strength checks.

regras.label: Luck
regras.text: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, reroll it and use the new roll.

effects.reroll: natural 1 on the d20, must use the new roll

regras.label: Powerful Build
regras.text: Advantage on ability checks to end the Grappled condition.

regras.label: Stone's Endurance
regras.text: Reaction when you take damage: roll 1d12 plus your Constitution modifier and reduce the damage by that total.

regras.label: Storm's Thunder
regras.text: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet damages you: it takes 1d8 Thunder damage.

when.situation: reaction when taking damage from a creature within 60 ft

regras.label: Dark One's Own Luck
regras.text: Add 1d10 to an ability check or Saving Throw after seeing the result; once per roll.

regras.label: Hurl Through Hell
regras.text: When you hit with an attack, the target makes a Charisma Saving Throw (spell save DC); on a failure it takes 8d10 Psychic damage (not Fiend) and has the Incapacitated condition until the end of your next turn.

when.situation: once per turn on a hit

cost.resource: or spend a Pact Magic slot

regras.label: Empowered Evocation
regras.text: Add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of a Wizard spell from the Evocation school.
regras.auto: Wizard spell of the Evocation school

regras.label: Overchannel
regras.text: Wizard spell that deals damage, using a level 1-5 slot: deal maximum damage this turn. From the second use before a Long Rest, you take 2d12 Necrotic damage per spell level (+1d12 per extra use).

effects.replace: the spell's damage dice go to their maximum value

regras.label: Potent Cantrip
regras.text: Damaging cantrip: if you miss the attack or the target succeeds on the save, it still takes half damage, with no additional effect.

effects.other: half damage on a missed attack or the target's successful saving throw

regras.label: Sculpt Spells
regras.text: Evocation spell: 1 plus the spell's level chosen creatures automatically succeed on the Saving Throw and take no damage if they would normally take half.

when.situation: chosen targets of an Evocation spell you cast

effects.other: automatic success on the saving throw, no damage

regras.label: Careful Spell (Saving Throw Targets)
regras.text: Notice (1 Sorcery Point, on a spell with a Saving Throw): choose up to your Charisma modifier creatures (minimum 1); they automatically succeed on the save and take no damage if they would normally take half. Tell the DM which ones.

effects.other: Careful Spell (1 Sorcery Point, on a spell with a saving throw): choose up to Charisma mod. creatures (min. 1); they automatically succeed on the save and take no damage if they would normally take half. Tell the DM which ones.
